title: First attempt at a simple game
author: deadlock_eire
selftext:
I decided to see what AI could do so I made a simple start with a cute pixel art version of kalaha with cats (instead of stones).

I went with playgama as I thought it would be an easy starting place, but where I made the mistake was that I hadn't added a tutorial or decent instructions and built them in after I had got the initial plays, so the average game time is below the required 5 mins. 

As a result it won't publish and stays in their sandbox.

Anyhow, here it is - any and all advice is appreciated:

https://playgama.ai/play/i3szm6hfm3466t
